name: Game Over
description: Terminal state in BJJ where a match ends through submission. Every submission technique leads here - the ultimate objective of submission grappling.
overview: Game Over is the terminal state in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu where a match ends through submission. This node represents the ultimate objective of submission grappling: forcing your opponent to acknowledge defeat through a tap (verbal or physical) due to a joint lock or choke. In the state machine model, this is a sink node - once reached, the match resets.
state_invariants: One practitioner has achieved a tap through joint lock or choke
No further transitions are possible from this state
This is a sink node in the state machine graph
